papers.title: Ti6Al4V lightweight lattice structures manufactured by laser powder bed fusion for load-bearing applications
papers.first_author_affiliation: CT Scanner Facility, Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch 7602, South Africa

corresponding_authors.name: Anton du Plessis
corresponding_authors.affiliation: CT Scanner Facility, Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch 7602, South Africa

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF制造的Ti6Al4V点阵结构的力学性能，与用户关注的增材制造生物医用植入物方向相关。
llm.why_not_core: No fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration data, and no direct link to stress shielding or implant stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索LPBF制造Ti6Al4V点阵结构在承重应用中的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 设计并制造多种点阵结构，进行准静态压缩测试。
summary_zh.result: 点阵结构的力学性能与相对密度相关，某些结构具有高比强度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验压缩测试验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the mechanical performance of Ti6Al4V lattice structures fabricated by laser powder bed fusion for potential load-bearing applications.
summary_en.method: Various lattice unit cell designs were manufactured via LPBF and subjected to quasi-static compression tests.
summary_en.result: The mechanical properties, including stiffness and strength, were found to be strongly dependent on relative density, with some designs exhibiting high specific strength.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression testing was used to validate the mechanical response of the lattice structures.

papers.title: Adaptive <scp>SAR</scp> mass‐averaging framework to improve predictions of local <scp>RF</scp> heating near a hip implant for parallel transmit at 7 <scp>T</scp>
papers.abstract: Purpose Magnetic resonance imaging is used increasingly to scan patients with hip prostheses. We evaluated the reliability of 10 g–averaged specific absorption rate (SAR 10g ) to predict radiofrequency (RF) heating in tissues surrounding a hip implant at 7 T in an 8‐channel pTx hip coil. A new adaptive SAR mass‐averaging method is proposed to improve the correlation between the distribution of mass‐averaged SAR and that of tissue temperature. Methods Currently, RF safety standards for implants are based on temperature instead of SAR, as SAR has not been introduced with regard to exposure scenarios with implants. In this manuscript, however, adaptive SAR is proposed for fast and reliable exposure evaluation with implants, after its correlation with tissue temperature is verified. A framework to calculate adaptive SAR mass‐averaging was introduced, which uses a different averaging mass in tissues surrounding the implants and was designed to prevent the temperature from exceeding 39ºC. Predictions from SAR 10g and adaptive SAR were compared with thermal simulations. Results The SAR 10g method failed to predict both the location and amplitude of heating in tissue near the metal implants. In some cases, the temperature far exceeded 39ºC even when SAR 10g was only 70% of the maximum allowed 10 W/kg. The distributions of adaptive SAR and temperature matched in most of the configurations, and the temperature remained below 39ºC when adaptive SAR was constrained. Conclusion Adaptive SAR can accurately monitor RF heating and could be used for parallel transmit at 7 T to supplement current standards.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于MRI射频加热安全性，而非髋关节植入物的生物力学性能，与用户研究方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on RF heating safety in MRI, not biomechanical performance of hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估SAR10g预测髋关节植入物射频加热的可靠性，提出自适应SAR方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应SAR质量平均框架，与热模拟比较验证。
summary_zh.result: SAR10g无法准确预测加热位置和幅度，自适应SAR与温度分布匹配。
summary_zh.validation: 通过热模拟对比SAR10g和自适应SAR的预测效果。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the reliability of 10g-averaged SAR for predicting RF heating near hip implants at 7T and propose an adaptive SAR method.
summary_en.method: An adaptive SAR mass-averaging framework was introduced, using different averaging masses in tissues near implants, and compared with thermal simulations.
summary_en.result: SAR10g failed to predict heating location and amplitude, while adaptive SAR distributions matched temperature distributions and kept temperature below 39°C.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing adaptive SAR predictions with thermal simulations for various configurations.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究多孔碳化钛陶瓷，与生物医学植入物中的钛合金LPBF工艺及应力屏蔽无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on TiC ceramics, not LPBF-fabricated titanium alloys; no stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TiC添加对多孔碳化钛陶瓷微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同TiC含量的多孔陶瓷并测试压缩和断裂行为。
summary_zh.result: TiC添加提高了陶瓷的强度和断裂韧性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜和力学测试验证微观结构与性能关系。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of TiC addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties of porous titanium carbide ceramics.
summary_en.method: Porous ceramics with varying TiC content were fabricated and subjected to compression and fracture tests.
summary_en.result: TiC addition enhanced the strength and fracture toughness of the porous ceramics.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization via SEM and mechanical testing validated the structure-property relationships.
